opening_message:
Ticket 1: Kathryn Bishop (employee ID E023) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E023.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Kathryn Bishop (E023) is a full-time Engineer. Requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write; write is at the maximum for this role, so recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E023 is a contractor with basic training. Contractors with basic training max out at read; requested write exceeds this, so recommend read.
reason: HR, the authoritative source for employment type, lists E023 as a full-time Engineer. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not the Engineer role, so the maximum for a full-time employee is write (admin is not allowed since the employee's role does not own Payroll). The requested level (write) is at or below that maximum, so write is granted. Note: the Security note conflicts on employment type (contractor, basic training); however, based on HR's employment record, write is within policy.
